disposition_reason: The final ICML paper reports ordered encoding/decoding endpoints, numerical multi-session NEDS baselines and the original held-out-animal design. An executable same-task comparison is blocked by unresolved original data/trial provenance, paper/code preprocessing discrepancies and native baseline qualification. The local ridge reference is not the paper model.

source_paper.title: Neural Encoding and Decoding at Scale

evidence.locator: Final ICML paper Sections 3.1, 4.1, 5.2; Table 1; Appendices A, C and E Table 10
evidence.supports: Original cohort, task masks, transfer/fine-tuning design, score definitions and reported NEDS baselines; final publisher PDF inspected through an existing primary-source recovery receipt.

evidence.locator: Datasets and Models; training/evaluation script instructions
evidence.supports: Author baseline route and distinction between pretraining and held-out session lists.

evidence.locator: Complete 74-line session roster at pinned revision
Complete 10-line session roster at pinned revision

evidence.supports: 20-ms bins, stimulus-aligned two-second windows, code unit threshold and seeded 70/10/20 trial allocation.
Evaluation modality masks, Poisson-gain metric, neuron mean, classification accuracy and flattened un-clipped trial R2.
Eligibility, alignment, validity-mask and scaling provenance requiring paper/code reconciliation.

target.description: Predict neural spiking from all four behaviors and each behavior individually, and decode choice, block, wheel speed and whisker motion from spikes after multi-session pretraining and target-session fine-tuning. Preserve the full endpoint vector.

dataset.description: IBL repeated-site Neuropixels and behavioral recordings. Exact historical ONE object versions/checksums and processed arrays linked to the reported results remain unresolved; substituting a current download is not demonstrated parity.

cohort.description: Use all 74 pinned pretraining sessions and 10 pinned held-out sessions. The paper describes 73 pretraining animals plus 10 test animals, with two insertions from one training animal; authenticate the EID/probe/animal join before biological inference.

split.description: Original design fine-tunes each held-out animal using its 70% training trials, selects on 10% validation and scores 20% test. Source uses a seeded random permutation after eligibility processing. Exact original trial IDs/order and exclusion-dependent RNG sequence must be recovered.

inputs.description: Encoding reveals only the declared all-behavior or single-behavior variables and hides every spike target; decoding reveals spikes and hides all four behaviors. Reward, target aliases, test-derived null rates and arbitrary auxiliary modalities are not candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: 20-ms spike/behavior bins in stimulus-aligned [-0.5,1.5]-s windows. Paper excludes neurons below 2 Hz, while pinned prepare_data.py retains mean_fr>1/0.2 (>5 Hz). Original eligibility, validity-mask handling, behavior scaling and camera lineage require reconciliation rather than silent repair.

metric.description: Encoding: each neuron has [Poisson log likelihood(prediction)-log likelihood(evaluation-mean null)]/(total spikes*ln(2)). Choice/block use ordinary accuracy; wheel/whisker use un-clipped R2 across flattened test trials/time bins. Preserve source zero-rate/undefined-neuron behavior and audit its effects.

aggregation.description: Average defined neuron bits/spike within each test session, then report the ten-session mean and animal-level paired effects. Retain each behavioral endpoint separately; never average bits/spike, R2 and accuracy into one undocumented score.

comparison.primary_metric: All-behavior neural encoding bits/spike on the original ten held-out animals after multi-session pretraining and fine-tuning

published_baseline.description: Final ICML Table 1 and Appendix E Table 10 report NEDS encoding 0.27 bits/spike (SEM 0.03). Table 10 companion means: choice accuracy 0.91, block accuracy 0.86, wheel R2 0.64, whisker R2 0.59. These are source scores, not reruns.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authentic native multi-session NEDS rerun is qualified. The pinned author repository exposes preparation, pretraining, target-session fine-tuning and evaluation routes, but historical recipe/data discrepancies must be resolved first. The constructed ridge implementation is not NEDS or the exact author linear/RRR comparator.

minimum_effect.rationale: Predeclare a task-specific bits/spike gain and acceptable joint decoding behavior after author-rerun variability and source rounding are qualified. Published SEM is not a meaningful-effect threshold and does not authorize a universal margin.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired animal-level inference on candidate-minus-author scores with the original ten held-out animals; report seed variability separately and account for the multi-endpoint decision.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Held-out mouse after authentic session/probe/animal identity join; neurons, time bins and trials are nested observations.
uncertainty.rationale: The paper reports mean and SEM across ten animals/sessions. A fabricated independent-neuron sample size or the local conditional bootstrap cannot establish a qualified paper win.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact original cohort, eligible units, aligned trials, input masks, preprocessing and 70/10/20 partitions; resolve paper/code discrepancies against source result provenance.

Run native author NEDS and the frozen candidate with identical pretraining/fine-tuning exposure and fixed resource budgets; retain all 74 training and ten held-out sessions without a convenient subset.
Surpass published 0.27 encoding bits/spike and the qualified author rerun by the predeclared meaningful effect and uncertainty rule on the same original endpoint.

Evaluate all single-behavior encoding and four decoding outcomes with a predeclared joint/trade-off rule; an encoding improvement alone cannot silently replace the registered simultaneous encoding/decoding task.

Do not call a new animal split, corrected-preprocessing variant, local ridge win, improved p-value or reproduced figure a source-paper win; report such results separately as calibration or extensions.

current_sota.description: Table 10 is a historical source comparison with RRR, NDT2 and POYO+. No present-SOTA comparison is established.

episode.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate with the original source pretraining sessions and target-session training/validation partitions, preserving task masks. Use validation to select methods and hyperparameters; maintain explicit separate neural and behavioral feedback.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate and author implementations, original-object/unit/trial manifests, mask contract, preprocessing resolution, hyperparameters, seeds, pretrained exposure, resources and joint endpoint decision before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate all original held-out test trials for the same ten target animals after source-permitted fine-tuning; compare the complete endpoint vector with the authentic author baseline. Preserve per-animal results and disclose original public test exposure. A different split remains an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep final published NEDS scores, a future native rerun, local engineering ridge scores and any separately verified current-SOTA results distinct. A rerun with repaired preprocessing cannot be attributed to the published paper without provenance.

blocking_issues: Authenticate historical ONE object revisions, eligible neurons/trials and exact original split identities; reconcile 2-Hz paper versus >5-Hz code eligibility.
Resolve presplit behavioral scaling, validity-mask combination and camera lineage against original result-producing artifacts; silent leakage repairs create a changed task.
Verify the complete native evaluation path and author checkpoint provenance, including full-trial versus potential final-batch behavior; qualify all source endpoint values.
Authenticate EID/probe/animal joins, including the training animal with two insertions, before uncertainty calculations.
Qualify native author rerun, source-session completeness, meaningful effect and joint multi-endpoint inference; the constructed ridge and generated controls cannot satisfy these gates.
Fix concrete training/validation/final-query and resource budgets with protected final scoring before opening an improvement episode.

legacy.notes: Retain the original registration and initial-evaluator-v1 for calibration. Its complete-cohort packets and source-derived metric kernels are useful engineering checks, but its train-only ridge, repaired inclusion/scaling choices and conditional animal bootstrap are prospective constructions rather than source-author results.
